滚轮转动带相纸上行，转角与推出距离相对应；真实即时相纸也借滚轮挤压、铺开显影药剂: Turning rollers move the paper upward; their rotation follows the ejection distance. Real instant film also uses rollers to spread developing chemicals.

风景已完整显现，相纸停在出片口；取走收藏后，才能拍摄下一张。: The image has fully appeared and the paper rests in the slot. Collect it before taking another picture.
照片向上离开出片口；完全取走后才计入收藏，下一张拍摄随后解锁。: The photo leaves through the top slot. It is added to the collection only when fully removed, then the next shot is unlocked.
纸盒盖打开后合回；装入动作完成时，剩余相纸才恢复为五张。: The pack door opens and closes. The remaining count returns to five when loading finishes.
按钮已下沉，还没有消耗相纸；松开才拍摄，移开或按 Esc 取消。: The button is held down, but no film has been used. Release to shoot; move away or press Esc to cancel.
按住快门，再松开触发曝光、出片与显影；取景为程序绘制的风景，不需要摄像头权限。: Hold the shutter, then release for exposure, ejection and development. The scene is generated; camera permission is not required.
五张相纸已用完，快门不会继续消耗相纸；装入新纸盒后才能拍摄。: All five sheets are used. The shutter cannot use another sheet until a new pack is loaded.
这是观察定格，不是实机暂停化学反应。: Observation is frozen; a real film's chemical reaction cannot be paused.

纸盒正在装入；盖子合回后，余量才恢复为五张。: Loading the pack. The count returns to five when the door closes.
这一盒相纸已用完。先装入五张新相纸，再进行曝光；空盒按快门不会消耗相纸。: This pack is empty. Load five new sheets before exposing another photo; pressing the shutter with an empty pack uses no film.
按下再松开机身快门才曝光，并消耗一张相纸；此时还没有送纸。程序风景代替实拍，不调: Press and release the body shutter to expose and use one sheet. Paper has not moved yet. Generated scenery replaces a real photograph; no camera is accessed.
曝光后的相纸被滚轮向上夹送；滚轮也将纸内药剂铺开。这里仅画走纸联动。: The exposed paper moves upward through the rollers. Real rollers also spread chemicals within the film; this model shows only the paper-feed linkage.
相纸已送出，滚轮停止，颜色继续显现。真实显影可在出片时开始；这里用缩短时长的颜色: The paper has emerged and the rollers have stopped, while colour keeps appearing. Real development can begin during ejection; this model represents it with a shortened colour transition.
等颜色完整显现，再点击照片取走。完全离开出片口后才计入收藏，重复点击不会多收一张: Wait for the full image, then click the photo to collect it. It counts only after fully leaving the slot; repeated clicks cannot collect another copy.
曝光完成，相纸尚未开始上行。: Exposure complete. The paper has not started moving upward.
相纸已全部推出，滚轮刚刚停住。: The paper has fully emerged and the rollers have just stopped.

简化示意：按快门、滚轮出片，再等待显影。风景由程序绘制，不需要摄像头权限；显影时: Simplified sequence: press the shutter, eject through the rollers, then wait for development. Scenery is generated, so no camera permission is required. The timing does not represent real film.
按住机身红色快门会看到它下沉，松开时拍摄；按住后移开或按 Esc 可取消；也可点: Hold the red body shutter to depress it, then release to shoot. Move away or press Esc while holding to cancel. You can also use the left shutter button, or focus the body shutter and press Enter or Space. Wait for full development before collecting the photo. Each pack holds five sheets and can be replaced only when empty. Start again cancels the current process.
